#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end API smoke test for the Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery system.

Runs against a freshly reset, running application:
    bash app-setup/reset.sh && ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123 bash app-setup/start.sh &
    python3 scripts/smoke_test.py

Only the Python standard library is required.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

BASE = os.environ.get("API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api")
ADMIN_USERNAME = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")

failures = 0


def iso(t):
    return t.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            status, payload = resp.status, json.loads(resp.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path}: expected {expect}, got {status}: {payload}")
    return status, payload


def check(cond, msg):
    global failures
    if cond:
        print(f"  ok   {msg}")
    else:
        failures += 1
        print(f"  FAIL {msg}")


def login(username, password, role=None):
    _, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": username, "password": password}, expect=200)
    tok = r["data"]["sessionToken"]
    if role:
        call("POST", "/select-active-role", {"role": role}, tok, expect=200)
    return tok, r["data"]["userId"]


def key():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    print("== authentication")
    s, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": "wrong"})
    check(s == 401 and r["code"] == "invalid_credentials", "wrong password rejected")
    admin, admin_id = login(ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD, "administrator")
    s, r = call("GET", "/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(r["data"]["user"]["activeRole"] == "administrator", "bootstrap returns active role")

    print("== network setup")
    types = {}
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, admin, expect=200)
    _, boot = call("GET", "/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    # sample types are seeded; discover them via create failing on duplicate names is not possible, so read via a probe request
    # The bootstrap payload does not include sample types; use the admin create endpoint for a custom type and the seeded ones via search.
    _, audit = call("POST", "/search-audit-trail", {"action": "sample_type_seeded", "limit": 50}, admin, expect=200)
    for e in audit["data"]["entries"]:
        types[e["details"]["name"]] = e["entityId"]
    check(set(["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"]).issubset(types), f"default sample types present: {sorted(types)}")

    def mk_loc(name, lat, lng, fns, handling=5):
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-location", {"name": name, "coordinate": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lng}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": handling, "active": True, "functions": fns}, admin, expect=201)
        return r["data"]["locationId"]

    cp = mk_loc("Indiranagar Collection Centre", 12.9719, 77.6412, ["collection_point", "transfer_point"])
    hub = mk_loc("Central Hub", 12.9716, 77.5946, ["hub", "transfer_point"])
    lab = mk_loc("Koramangala Laboratory", 12.9352, 77.6245, ["laboratory"])
    lab2 = mk_loc("Whitefield Laboratory", 12.9698, 77.7500, ["laboratory", "collection_point"])
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab, lab2):
        call("POST", "/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc, "capacityUnits": 20, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, admin, expect=200)

    def mk_conn(a, b, mins, cooled=True):
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": a, "toLocationId": b, "travelMinutes": mins, "costUnits": mins, "cooled": cooled, "active": True}, admin, expect=201)
        cid = r["data"]["connectionId"]
        call("POST", "/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 4}, admin, expect=200)
        return cid

    c1 = mk_conn(cp, hub, 30)
    c2 = mk_conn(hub, lab, 25)

def iso(t):

def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)

    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path}: expected {expect}, got {status}: {payload}")
    return status, payload

    return tok, r["data"]["userId"]


def key():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    print("== authentication")
    s, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": "wrong"})
    check(s == 401 and r["code"] == "invalid_credentials", "wrong password rejected")
    admin, admin_id = login(ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD, "administrator")
    s, r = call("GET", "/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(r["data"]["user"]["activeRole"] == "administrator", "bootstrap returns active role")

    print("== network setup")
    types = {}
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, admin, expect=200)
    _, boot = call("GET", "/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    # sample types are seeded; discover them via create failing on duplicate names is not possible, so read via a probe request
    # The bootstrap payload does not include sample types; use the admin create endpoint for a custom type and the seeded ones via search.
    _, audit = call("POST", "/search-audit-trail", {"action": "sample_type_seeded", "limit": 50}, admin, expect=200)
    for e in audit["data"]["entries"]:
        types[e["details"]["name"]] = e["entityId"]
    check(set(["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"]).issubset(types), f"default sample types present: {sorted(types)}")

    def mk_loc(name, lat, lng, fns, handling=5):
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-location", {"name": name, "coordinate": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lng}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": handling, "active": True, "functions": fns}, admin, expect=201)
        return r["data"]["locationId"]

    cp = mk_loc("Indiranagar Collection Centre", 12.9719, 77.6412, ["collection_point", "transfer_point"])
    hub = mk_loc("Central Hub", 12.9716, 77.5946, ["hub", "transfer_point"])
    lab = mk_loc("Koramangala Laboratory", 12.9352, 77.6245, ["laboratory"])
    lab2 = mk_loc("Whitefield Laboratory", 12.9698, 77.7500, ["laboratory", "collection_point"])
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab, lab2):
        call("POST", "/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc, "capacityUnits": 20, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, admin, expect=200)

    def mk_conn(a, b, mins, cooled=True):
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": a, "toLocationId": b, "travelMinutes": mins, "costUnits": mins, "cooled": cooled, "active": True}, admin, expect=201)
        cid = r["data"]["connectionId"]
        call("POST", "/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 4}, admin, expect=200)
        return cid

    c1 = mk_conn(cp, hub, 30)
    c2 = mk_conn(hub, lab, 25)
    c3 = mk_conn(cp, lab2, 60)
    for t in ("Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"):
        call("POST", "/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab, "sampleTypeId": types[t], "accepts": True}, admin, expect=200)
    call("POST", "/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab2, "sampleTypeId": types["Amber"], "accepts": True}, admin, expect=200)

    _, snap = call("POST", "/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, admin, expect=200)
    check(snap["data"]["status"] == "complete" and snap["data"]["activeCollectionPointCount"] == 2, "serviceability snapshot complete")

    print("== users")
    def mk_user(username, roles, quals=None, loc=None):
        body = {"username": username, "initialPassword": "pw-" + username, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        if quals:
            body["qualifications"] = quals
            body["certifications"] = [{"code": q, "active": True} for q in quals]
        if loc:
            body["assignedLocationId"] = loc
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-user", body, admin, expect=201)
        return r["data"]["userId"]

    req_id = mk_user("requester1", ["requester"])
    col_id = mk_user("collector1", ["collection_professional", "delivery_partner"], ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"])
    cour_id = mk_user("courier1", ["delivery_partner"])
    cour2_id = mk_user("courier2", ["delivery_partner"])
    hub_id = mk_user("hubhandler", ["node_handler"], loc=hub)
    labop_id = mk_user("labop", ["laboratory_team"], loc=lab)
    disp_id = mk_user("dispatcher1", ["dispatcher"])
    s, r = call("POST", "/create-user", {"username": "requester1", "initialPassword": "x", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, admin)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "username_exists", "duplicate username rejected")

    # multi-role user must select a role
    _, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": "collector1", "password": "pw-collector1"}, expect=200)
    col_tok = r["data"]["sessionToken"]
    check(r["data"]["activeRole"] == "", "multi-role user starts without active role")
    s, r = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, col_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "role_not_selected", "work view requires role selection")
    s, r = call("POST", "/select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, col_tok)
    check(s == 403 and r["code"] == "role_not_held", "cannot select unheld role")
    _, r = call("POST", "/select-active-role", {"role": "collection_professional"}, col_tok, expect=200)
    check(sorted(r["data"]["roles"]) == ["collection_professional", "delivery_partner"], "role switch keeps all roles")

    requester, _ = login("requester1", "pw-requester1")
    courier, _ = login("courier1", "pw-courier1")
    courier2, _ = login("courier2", "pw-courier2")
    hubh, _ = login("hubhandler", "pw-hubhandler")
    labop, _ = login("labop", "pw-labop")
    dispatcher, _ = login("dispatcher1", "pw-dispatcher1")

    print("== serviceability (dry run)")
    origin = {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6400}
    body = {"origin": origin, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": types["Frost"], "requestedAt": iso(now), "deliveryDeadline": iso(now + timedelta(hours=6)),
            "earliestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(minutes=10)), "latestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=2))}
    _, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", body, requester, expect=200)
    check(r["data"]["serviceable"] and r["data"]["targetLaboratoryId"] == lab, f"home origin serviceable -> {r['data']['reason']}")
    far = dict(body, origin={"latitude": 13.3, "longitude": 77.9})
    _, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", far, requester, expect=200)
    check(not r["data"]["serviceable"] and r["data"]["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage", "far origin outside coverage")
    tight = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=20)), latestCollectionAt=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=15)))
    _, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", tight, requester, expect=200)
    check(not r["data"]["serviceable"] and r["data"]["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", "impossible deadline unreachable")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, requester, expect=200)
    check(work["data"] == {"pending": [], "inProgress": [], "completed": []}, "dry run created nothing")
    s, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now - timedelta(hours=1))), requester)
    check(s == 400 and r["code"] == "invalid_deadline", "deadline before request rejected")

    print("== collection request")
    body.update({"containerType": "cryovial", "temperatureMinC": -20, "temperatureMaxC": -10, "idempotencyKey": key()})
    _, r = call("POST", "/create-collection-request", body, requester, expect=201)
    sample = r["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey = r["data"]["journeyId"]
    check(r["data"]["serviceability"] == "serviceable" and journey, "request created with journey")
    _, r2 = call("POST", "/create-collection-request", body, requester, expect=201)
    check(r2["data"]["sampleId"] == sample, "idempotent replay returns same sample")
    _, st = call("GET", f"/read-sample-state/{sample}", token=requester, expect=200)
    check(st["data"]["state"]["status"] == "requested" and st["data"]["locationStale"] is True, "sample state readable by owner")
    s, _ = call("GET", f"/read-sample-state/{sample}", token=courier)
    check(s == 403, "unrelated worker cannot read sample")
    _, plan = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    legs = plan["data"]["legs"]
    check(len(legs) == 2 and plan["data"]["routeMode"] == "multi_stop", f"journey has 2 transport legs via hub ({plan['data']['routeMode']})")
    check(plan["data"]["collectionAssignmentId"] and len(plan["data"]["nodeAssignmentIds"]) == 1 and len(plan["data"]["laboratoryAssignmentIds"]) == 1, "collection/node/lab assignments created")
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    hub_loc = [l for l in ops["data"]["locations"] if l["locationId"] == hub][0]
    check(hub_loc["capacity"]["cooledReservedUnits"] == 1, "cooled capacity reserved at hub")

    print("== collection")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, col_tok, expect=200)
    offered = [w for w in work["data"]["pending"] if w["kind"] == "collection"]
    check(len(offered) == 1, "collection offered to qualified collector")
    coll_as = offered[0]["assignmentId"]
    s, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, courier)
    check(s in (403, 409), f"other worker cannot accept offer ({r['code']})")
    _, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "accepted", "collector accepted")
    s, r = call("POST", "/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample, "assignmentId": coll_as, "collectedAt": iso(now), "containerType": "cryovial", "observedTemperatureC": -15, "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "outside_collection_window", "collection outside window rejected")
    t_collect = now + timedelta(minutes=30)
    _, r = call("POST", "/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample, "assignmentId": coll_as, "collectedAt": iso(t_collect), "containerType": "cryovial", "observedTemperatureC": -15, "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "sealed" and r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id and r["data"]["handlingCompliant"], "sample sealed, collector holds custody")
    _, r = call("POST", "/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, col_tok, expect=201)
    s, r = call("POST", "/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, col_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "stale_location", "stale location sequence rejected")

    print("== first transport leg")
    leg1 = legs[0]["assignmentId"]
    leg2 = legs[1]["assignmentId"]
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier, expect=200)
    _, work2 = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier2, expect=200)
    offered_to = {courier: work, courier2: work2}
    first_tok = None
    for tok, w in offered_to.items():
        for item in w["data"]["pending"]:
            if item["assignmentId"] == leg1:
                first_tok = tok
    check(first_tok is not None, "leg 1 offered to exactly one courier")
    other_tok = courier2 if first_tok == courier else courier
    _, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    first_id = r["data"]["workerId"]
    s, r = call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=5)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "custody_required", "pickup before handoff rejected")
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": coll_as, "toAssignmentId": leg1, "receiverId": first_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=5)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    h1 = r["data"]["handoffId"]
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=6)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "pending" and r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "sender confirmed; custody unchanged until receiver confirms")
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=7)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "confirmed" and r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == first_id, "custody transferred to courier")
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=8)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "confirmed", "repeated confirmation is idempotent")
    _, r = call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=10)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    _, r = call("POST", "/record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample, "assignmentId": leg1, "containerType": "cryovial", "observedTemperatureC": -12, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=15)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["compliant"] and r["data"]["sampleStatus"] == "in_transit", "compliant checkpoint recorded")
    _, r = call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=40)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "arrived", "courier arrived at hub")

    print("== hub handling")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, hubh, expect=200)
    node_as = [w for w in work["data"]["pending"] if w["kind"] == "node"]
    check(len(node_as) == 1 and node_as[0]["nodeId"] == hub, "node assignment offered to hub handler")
    node_as = node_as[0]["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": node_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, hubh, expect=201)
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": leg1, "toAssignmentId": node_as, "receiverId": hub_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=41)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    h2 = r["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h2, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=42)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, hubh, expect=201)
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h2, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=42)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == hub_id, "hub handler holds the sample")
    _, lc = call("POST", "/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(lc["data"]["status"] == "at_node" and leg1 in lc["data"]["completedLegIds"], "leg 1 completed, sample at node")
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    c1_conn = [c for c in ops["data"]["connections"] if c["connectionId"] == c1][0]
    check(c1_conn["capacity"]["cooledReservedUnits"] == 0, "connection capacity released after leg")

    print("== second leg to the laboratory")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier, expect=200)
    _, work2 = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier2, expect=200)
    second_tok = None
    for tok, w in ((courier, work), (courier2, work2)):
        for item in w["data"]["pending"]:
            if item["assignmentId"] == leg2:
                second_tok = tok
    check(second_tok is not None, "leg 2 offered to a courier")
    # decline and verify re-offer to the other courier
    _, r = call("POST", "/decline-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg2, "reason": "busy", "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "pending" and r["data"].get("reofferedTo") not in (None, r["data"]["declinedBy"]), "declined work re-offered to another courier")
    second_tok = courier2 if second_tok == courier else courier
    _, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg2, "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    second_id = r["data"]["workerId"]
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": node_as, "toAssignmentId": leg2, "receiverId": second_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=50)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, hubh, expect=201)
    h3 = r["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h3, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=51)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, hubh, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h3, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=51)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2, "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=55)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=80)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)

    print("== laboratory receipt")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, labop, expect=200)
    lab_as = [w for w in work["data"]["pending"] if w["kind"] == "laboratory"]
    check(len(lab_as) == 1 and lab_as[0]["laboratoryId"] == lab and lab_as[0]["expectedSampleTypeId"] == types["Frost"], "lab intake sees expected sample")
    lab_as = lab_as[0]["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": lab_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop, expect=201)
    s, r = call("POST", "/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=85)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "custody_conflict", "receipt before handoff rejected")
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": leg2, "toAssignmentId": lab_as, "receiverId": labop_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=81)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    h4 = r["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=82)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=82)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop, expect=201)
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=85)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "received", "sample received at laboratory")
    _, lc = call("POST", "/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample}, requester, expect=200)
    check(lc["data"]["status"] == "received" and lc["data"]["receivedLaboratoryId"] == lab, "lifecycle shows received")
    actions = [t["action"] for t in lc["data"]["timeline"]]
    check(actions == sorted(actions, key=lambda a: actions.index(a)) and "custody_transferred" in actions and "sample_sealed" in actions, f"timeline has {len(actions)} ordered entries")
    _, plan = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(plan["data"]["status"] == "completed", "journey completed")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, requester, expect=200)
    check(len(work["data"]["completed"]) == 1, "requester sees completed work")
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    lab_loc = [l for l in ops["data"]["locations"] if l["locationId"] == lab][0]
    check(lab_loc["capacity"]["cooledReservedUnits"] == 0 and lab_loc["capacity"]["reservedUnits"] == 0, "all capacity released after receipt")

    print("== disruption & replanning")
    body2 = dict(body, sampleTypeId=types["Amber"], containerType="vacutainer", temperatureMinC=2, temperatureMaxC=25, idempotencyKey=key())
    _, r = call("POST", "/create-collection-request", body2, requester, expect=201)
    s2, j2 = r["data"]["sampleId"], r["data"]["journeyId"]
    _, plan2 = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": j2}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(plan2["data"]["legs"][-1]["toLocationId"] == lab and plan2["data"]["planVersion"] == 1, "second sample routed via hub to lab")
    s, r = call("POST", "/cancel-journey", {"journeyId": j2, "expectedPlanVersion": 7, "idempotencyKey": key()}, dispatcher)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "stale_plan", "stale plan version rejected")
    _, r = call("POST", "/report-disruption", {"resourceType": "node", "resourceId": hub, "reason": "power outage", "occurredAt": iso(now), "idempotencyKey": key()}, dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["replanStatus"] == "replaced" and s2 in r["data"]["affectedSampleIds"], f"hub outage replanned ({r['data']['replanStatus']})")
    rep = r["data"]["replacementPlanIds"][0]
    _, plan3 = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": rep}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(plan3["data"]["legs"][-1]["toLocationId"] == lab2 and plan3["data"]["parentJourneyId"] == j2, "replacement goes directly to Whitefield lab")
    _, old = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": j2}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(old["data"]["status"] == "replaced" and old["data"]["replanStatus"] == "replaced" and old["data"]["replacementJourney"]["journeyId"] == rep, "old journey marked replaced")
    _, st = call("GET", f"/read-sample-state/{s2}", token=requester, expect=200)
    check(st["data"]["activeJourneyId"] == rep, "sample points at replacement journey")
    call("POST", "/set-location-status", {"locationId": hub, "active": True}, admin, expect=200)
    _, r = call("POST", "/cancel-journey", {"journeyId": rep, "expectedPlanVersion": 1, "reason": "patient cancelled", "idempotencyKey": key()}, dispatcher, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "cancelled", "journey cancelled")

    print("== pre-sealed ingestion & batching rules")
    pre = {"origin": {"latitude": 12.9716, "longitude": 77.5946}, "originType": "node", "originNodeId": hub, "requestedAt": iso(now), "deliveryDeadline": iso(now + timedelta(hours=5)),
           "sampleTypeId": types["Amber"], "containerType": "vacutainer", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25, "idempotencyKey": key()}
    _, r = call("POST", "/ingest-presealed-sample", pre, hubh, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["alreadySealed"] and r["data"]["journeyId"], "node handler registered pre-sealed sample")
    _, lc = call("POST", "/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": r["data"]["sampleId"]}, hubh, expect=200)
    check(lc["data"]["currentHolderId"] == hub_id and lc["data"]["sealed"], "registrant holds the pre-sealed sample")
    s, r = call("POST", "/ingest-presealed-sample", dict(pre, originType="home", idempotencyKey=key()), hubh)
    check(s == 400 and r["code"] == "invalid_origin_type", "pre-sealed home origin rejected")
    s, r = call("POST", "/create-sample-type", {"name": "Bad", "containerType": "x", "temperatureMinC": 10, "temperatureMaxC": 5}, admin)
    check(s == 400 and r["code"] == "invalid_handling_rule", "invalid sample type rule rejected")

    print("== audit")
    _, a = call("POST", "/search-audit-trail", {"entityId": sample, "order": "oldest_first", "limit": 100}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(a["data"]["total"] >= 8 and a["data"]["order"] == "oldest_first", f"audit search by sample returns {a['data']['total']} entries")
    _, a = call("POST", "/search-audit-trail", {"action": "sign_in", "limit": 5}, dispatcher, expect=200)

    s, _ = call("POST", "/search-audit-trail", {}, requester)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end API smoke test for the Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery system.

Runs against a freshly reset, running application:
    bash app-setup/reset.sh && ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123 bash app-setup/start.sh &
    python3 scripts/smoke_test.py

Only the Python standard library is required.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

BASE = os.environ.get("API_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api")
ADMIN_USERNAME = os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
ADMIN_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123")

failures = 0


def iso(t):
    return t.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            status, payload = resp.status, json.loads(resp.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, payload = e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b"{}")
    if expect is not None and status != expect:
        raise AssertionError(f"{method} {path}: expected {expect}, got {status}: {payload}")
    return status, payload


def check(cond, msg):
    global failures
    if cond:
        print(f"  ok   {msg}")
    else:
        failures += 1
        print(f"  FAIL {msg}")


def login(username, password, role=None):
    _, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": username, "password": password}, expect=200)
    tok = r["data"]["sessionToken"]
    if role:
        call("POST", "/select-active-role", {"role": role}, tok, expect=200)
    return tok, r["data"]["userId"]


def key():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    print("== authentication")
    s, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": "wrong"})
    check(s == 401 and r["code"] == "invalid_credentials", "wrong password rejected")
    admin, admin_id = login(ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD, "administrator")
    s, r = call("GET", "/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    check(r["data"]["user"]["activeRole"] == "administrator", "bootstrap returns active role")

    print("== network setup")
    types = {}
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, admin, expect=200)
    _, boot = call("GET", "/ui/bootstrap", token=admin, expect=200)
    # sample types are seeded; discover them via create failing on duplicate names is not possible, so read via a probe request
    # The bootstrap payload does not include sample types; use the admin create endpoint for a custom type and the seeded ones via search.
    _, audit = call("POST", "/search-audit-trail", {"action": "sample_type_seeded", "limit": 50}, admin, expect=200)
    for e in audit["data"]["entries"]:
        types[e["details"]["name"]] = e["entityId"]
    check(set(["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"]).issubset(types), f"default sample types present: {sorted(types)}")

    def mk_loc(name, lat, lng, fns, handling=5):
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-location", {"name": name, "coordinate": {"latitude": lat, "longitude": lng}, "coverageKm": 5, "handlingMinutes": handling, "active": True, "functions": fns}, admin, expect=201)
        return r["data"]["locationId"]

    cp = mk_loc("Indiranagar Collection Centre", 12.9719, 77.6412, ["collection_point", "transfer_point"])
    hub = mk_loc("Central Hub", 12.9716, 77.5946, ["hub", "transfer_point"])
    lab = mk_loc("Koramangala Laboratory", 12.9352, 77.6245, ["laboratory"])
    lab2 = mk_loc("Whitefield Laboratory", 12.9698, 77.7500, ["laboratory", "collection_point"])
    for loc in (cp, hub, lab, lab2):
        call("POST", "/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": loc, "capacityUnits": 20, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, admin, expect=200)

    def mk_conn(a, b, mins, cooled=True):
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-connection", {"fromLocationId": a, "toLocationId": b, "travelMinutes": mins, "costUnits": mins, "cooled": cooled, "active": True}, admin, expect=201)
        cid = r["data"]["connectionId"]
        call("POST", "/configure-capacity", {"resourceId": cid, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 4}, admin, expect=200)
        return cid

    c1 = mk_conn(cp, hub, 30)
    c2 = mk_conn(hub, lab, 25)
    c3 = mk_conn(cp, lab2, 60)
    for t in ("Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"):
        call("POST", "/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab, "sampleTypeId": types[t], "accepts": True}, admin, expect=200)
    call("POST", "/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {"laboratoryId": lab2, "sampleTypeId": types["Amber"], "accepts": True}, admin, expect=200)

    _, snap = call("POST", "/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, admin, expect=200)
    check(snap["data"]["status"] == "complete" and snap["data"]["activeCollectionPointCount"] == 2, "serviceability snapshot complete")

    print("== users")
    def mk_user(username, roles, quals=None, loc=None):
        body = {"username": username, "initialPassword": "pw-" + username, "roles": roles, "active": True}
        if quals:
            body["qualifications"] = quals
            body["certifications"] = [{"code": q, "active": True} for q in quals]
        if loc:
            body["assignedLocationId"] = loc
        _, r = call("POST", "/create-user", body, admin, expect=201)
        return r["data"]["userId"]

    req_id = mk_user("requester1", ["requester"])
    col_id = mk_user("collector1", ["collection_professional", "delivery_partner"], ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"])
    cour_id = mk_user("courier1", ["delivery_partner"])
    cour2_id = mk_user("courier2", ["delivery_partner"])
    hub_id = mk_user("hubhandler", ["node_handler"], loc=hub)
    labop_id = mk_user("labop", ["laboratory_team"], loc=lab)
    disp_id = mk_user("dispatcher1", ["dispatcher"])
    s, r = call("POST", "/create-user", {"username": "requester1", "initialPassword": "x", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, admin)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "username_exists", "duplicate username rejected")

    # multi-role user must select a role
    _, r = call("POST", "/authenticate-user", {"username": "collector1", "password": "pw-collector1"}, expect=200)
    col_tok = r["data"]["sessionToken"]
    check(r["data"]["activeRole"] == "", "multi-role user starts without active role")
    s, r = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, col_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "role_not_selected", "work view requires role selection")
    s, r = call("POST", "/select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, col_tok)
    check(s == 403 and r["code"] == "role_not_held", "cannot select unheld role")
    _, r = call("POST", "/select-active-role", {"role": "collection_professional"}, col_tok, expect=200)
    check(sorted(r["data"]["roles"]) == ["collection_professional", "delivery_partner"], "role switch keeps all roles")

    requester, _ = login("requester1", "pw-requester1")
    courier, _ = login("courier1", "pw-courier1")
    courier2, _ = login("courier2", "pw-courier2")
    hubh, _ = login("hubhandler", "pw-hubhandler")
    labop, _ = login("labop", "pw-labop")
    dispatcher, _ = login("dispatcher1", "pw-dispatcher1")

    print("== serviceability (dry run)")
    origin = {"latitude": 12.9750, "longitude": 77.6400}
    body = {"origin": origin, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": types["Frost"], "requestedAt": iso(now), "deliveryDeadline": iso(now + timedelta(hours=6)),
            "earliestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(minutes=10)), "latestCollectionAt": iso(now + timedelta(hours=2))}
    _, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", body, requester, expect=200)
    check(r["data"]["serviceable"] and r["data"]["targetLaboratoryId"] == lab, f"home origin serviceable -> {r['data']['reason']}")
    far = dict(body, origin={"latitude": 13.3, "longitude": 77.9})
    _, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", far, requester, expect=200)
    check(not r["data"]["serviceable"] and r["data"]["reason"] == "outside_service_coverage", "far origin outside coverage")
    tight = dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=20)), latestCollectionAt=iso(now + timedelta(minutes=15)))
    _, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", tight, requester, expect=200)
    check(not r["data"]["serviceable"] and r["data"]["reason"] == "deadline_unreachable", "impossible deadline unreachable")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, requester, expect=200)
    check(work["data"] == {"pending": [], "inProgress": [], "completed": []}, "dry run created nothing")
    s, r = call("POST", "/check-serviceability", dict(body, deliveryDeadline=iso(now - timedelta(hours=1))), requester)
    check(s == 400 and r["code"] == "invalid_deadline", "deadline before request rejected")

    print("== collection request")
    body.update({"containerType": "cryovial", "temperatureMinC": -20, "temperatureMaxC": -10, "idempotencyKey": key()})
    _, r = call("POST", "/create-collection-request", body, requester, expect=201)
    sample = r["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey = r["data"]["journeyId"]
    check(r["data"]["serviceability"] == "serviceable" and journey, "request created with journey")
    _, r2 = call("POST", "/create-collection-request", body, requester, expect=201)
    check(r2["data"]["sampleId"] == sample, "idempotent replay returns same sample")
    _, st = call("GET", f"/read-sample-state/{sample}", token=requester, expect=200)
    check(st["data"]["state"]["status"] == "requested" and st["data"]["locationStale"] is True, "sample state readable by owner")
    s, _ = call("GET", f"/read-sample-state/{sample}", token=courier)
    check(s == 403, "unrelated worker cannot read sample")
    _, plan = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    legs = plan["data"]["legs"]
    check(len(legs) == 2 and plan["data"]["routeMode"] == "multi_stop", f"journey has 2 transport legs via hub ({plan['data']['routeMode']})")
    check(plan["data"]["collectionAssignmentId"] and len(plan["data"]["nodeAssignmentIds"]) == 1 and len(plan["data"]["laboratoryAssignmentIds"]) == 1, "collection/node/lab assignments created")
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    hub_loc = [l for l in ops["data"]["locations"] if l["locationId"] == hub][0]
    check(hub_loc["capacity"]["cooledReservedUnits"] == 1, "cooled capacity reserved at hub")

    print("== collection")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, col_tok, expect=200)
    offered = [w for w in work["data"]["pending"] if w["kind"] == "collection"]
    check(len(offered) == 1, "collection offered to qualified collector")
    coll_as = offered[0]["assignmentId"]
    s, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, courier)
    check(s in (403, 409), f"other worker cannot accept offer ({r['code']})")
    _, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "accepted", "collector accepted")
    s, r = call("POST", "/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample, "assignmentId": coll_as, "collectedAt": iso(now), "containerType": "cryovial", "observedTemperatureC": -15, "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "outside_collection_window", "collection outside window rejected")
    t_collect = now + timedelta(minutes=30)
    _, r = call("POST", "/collect-and-seal-sample", {"sampleId": sample, "assignmentId": coll_as, "collectedAt": iso(t_collect), "containerType": "cryovial", "observedTemperatureC": -15, "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "sealed" and r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id and r["data"]["handlingCompliant"], "sample sealed, collector holds custody")
    _, r = call("POST", "/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, col_tok, expect=201)
    s, r = call("POST", "/record-worker-location", {"assignmentId": coll_as, "coordinate": origin, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect)}, col_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "stale_location", "stale location sequence rejected")

    print("== first transport leg")
    leg1 = legs[0]["assignmentId"]
    leg2 = legs[1]["assignmentId"]
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier, expect=200)
    _, work2 = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier2, expect=200)
    offered_to = {courier: work, courier2: work2}
    first_tok = None
    for tok, w in offered_to.items():
        for item in w["data"]["pending"]:
            if item["assignmentId"] == leg1:
                first_tok = tok
    check(first_tok is not None, "leg 1 offered to exactly one courier")
    other_tok = courier2 if first_tok == courier else courier
    _, r = call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    first_id = r["data"]["workerId"]
    s, r = call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "picked_up", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=5)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "custody_required", "pickup before handoff rejected")
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": coll_as, "toAssignmentId": leg1, "receiverId": first_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=5)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    h1 = r["data"]["handoffId"]
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=6)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, col_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "pending" and r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == col_id, "sender confirmed; custody unchanged until receiver confirms")
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=7)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "confirmed" and r["data"]["currentHolderId"] == first_id, "custody transferred to courier")
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h1, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=8)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "confirmed", "repeated confirmation is idempotent")
    _, r = call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=10)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    _, r = call("POST", "/record-handling-checkpoint", {"sampleId": sample, "assignmentId": leg1, "containerType": "cryovial", "observedTemperatureC": -12, "recordedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=15)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["compliant"] and r["data"]["sampleStatus"] == "in_transit", "compliant checkpoint recorded")
    _, r = call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=40)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, first_tok, expect=201)

    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, dispatcher, expect=200)

    check(c1_conn["capacity"]["cooledReservedUnits"] == 0, "connection capacity released after leg")

    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, courier, expect=200)

        for item in w["data"]["pending"]:

    check(second_tok is not None, "leg 2 offered to a courier")

    second_id = r["data"]["workerId"]
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": node_as, "toAssignmentId": leg2, "receiverId": second_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=50)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, hubh, expect=201)

    call("POST", "/update-assignment-progress", {"assignmentId": leg2, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=80)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)

    lab_as = lab_as[0]["assignmentId"]
    call("POST", "/accept-assignment", {"assignmentId": lab_as, "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop, expect=201)
    s, r = call("POST", "/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=85)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop)
    check(s == 409 and r["code"] == "custody_conflict", "receipt before handoff rejected")
    _, r = call("POST", "/initiate-handoff", {"sampleId": sample, "fromAssignmentId": leg2, "toAssignmentId": lab_as, "receiverId": labop_id, "initiatedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=81)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    h4 = r["data"]["handoffId"]
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=82)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, second_tok, expect=201)
    call("POST", "/confirm-handoff", {"handoffId": h4, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=82)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop, expect=201)
    _, r = call("POST", "/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {"sampleId": sample, "laboratoryId": lab, "receivedAt": iso(t_collect + timedelta(minutes=85)), "idempotencyKey": key()}, labop, expect=201)
    check(r["data"]["status"] == "received", "sample received at laboratory")
    _, lc = call("POST", "/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample}, requester, expect=200)
    check(lc["data"]["status"] == "received" and lc["data"]["receivedLaboratoryId"] == lab, "lifecycle shows received")
    actions = [t["action"] for t in lc["data"]["timeline"]]
    check(actions == sorted(actions, key=lambda a: actions.index(a)) and "custody_transferred" in actions and "sample_sealed" in actions, f"timeline has {len(actions)} ordered entries")
    _, plan = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    check(plan["data"]["status"] == "completed", "journey completed")
    _, work = call("POST", "/list-role-work", {}, requester, expect=200)
    check(len(work["data"]["completed"]) == 1, "requester sees completed work")
    _, ops = call("POST", "/read-operations-state", {}, dispatcher, expect=200)
    lab_loc = [l for l in ops["data"]["locations"] if l["locationId"] == lab][0]
    check(lab_loc["capacity"]["cooledReservedUnits"] == 0 and lab_loc["capacity"]["reservedUnits"] == 0, "all capacity released after receipt")

    print("== disruption & replanning")
    body2 = dict(body, sampleTypeId=types["Amber"], containerType="vacutainer", temperatureMinC=2, temperatureMaxC=25, idempotencyKey=key())
    _, r = call("POST", "/create-collection-request", body2, requester, expect=201)
    s2, j2 = r["data"]["sampleId"], r["data"]["journeyId"]
    _, plan2 = call("POST", "/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": j2}, dispatcher, expect=200)

export type Role =
  | 'administrator'
  | 'dispatcher'
  | 'requester'
  | 'collection_professional'
  | 'delivery_partner'
  | 'node_handler'
  | 'laboratory_team'

export const ALL_ROLES: Role[] = [
  'administrator',
  'dispatcher',
  'requester',
  'collection_professional',
  'delivery_partner',
  'node_handler',
  'laboratory_team',
]

export const ROLE_LABELS: Record<Role, string> = {
  administrator: 'Administrator',
  dispatcher: 'Dispatcher',
  requester: 'Requester',
  collection_professional: 'Certified collection professional',
  delivery_partner: 'Relay courier',
  node_handler: 'Node handler',
  laboratory_team: 'Laboratory intake operator',
}

export type LocationFunction = 'collection_point' | 'transfer_point' | 'hub' | 'laboratory'
export const LOCATION_FUNCTIONS: LocationFunction[] = ['collection_point', 'transfer_point', 'hub', 'laboratory']

export interface Coordinate {
  latitude: number
  longitude: number
}

export interface Capacity {
  capacityUnits: number
  reservedUnits: number
  availableUnits: number
  cooledCapacityUnits: number
  cooledReservedUnits: number
  cooledAvailableUnits: number
}

export interface LocationFunctionStates {
  collection_point?: boolean
  transfer_point?: boolean
  hub?: boolean
  laboratory?: boolean
}

export interface Location {
  locationId: string
  name: string
  coordinate: Coordinate
  coverageKm: number
  handlingMinutes: number
  active: boolean
  functions: LocationFunctionStates
  capacity?: Capacity
  acceptedSampleTypeIds?: string[]
}

export interface SampleType {
  sampleTypeId: string
  name: string
  qualifiedCollectorRequired: boolean
  requiredQualification: string
  containerType: string
  temperatureMinC: number
  temperatureMaxC: number
  incompatibleSampleTypes: string[]
  requiresCooledRoute: boolean
  batchingAllowed: boolean
}

export interface Connection {
  id?: string
  connectionId: string
  fromLocationId: string
  toLocationId: string
  travelMinutes: number
  costUnits: number
  cooled: boolean
  active: boolean
  capacity?: Capacity
}

export interface TimelineEntry {
  eventId: number
  action: string
  actorId: string
  role: string
  entityType: string
  entityId: string
  success: boolean
  occurredAt: string
  details: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface SampleState {
  sampleId: string
  requestId: string
  requesterId: string
  origin: Coordinate
  originType: 'home' | 'clinic' | 'node'
  requestedAt: string
  deliveryDeadline: string
  sampleTypeId: string
  containerType: string
  temperatureMinC: number
  temperatureMaxC: number
  incompatibleSampleTypes: string[]
  serviceability: 'serviceable' | 'unserviceable'
  activeAssignmentIds: string[]
  state: { status: string }
  timeline: TimelineEntry[]
  activeJourneyId?: string
  targetLaboratoryId?: string
  latestLocation?: Coordinate
  locationRecordedAt?: string
  locationStale: boolean
}

export interface SampleLifecycle {
  sampleId: string
  status: string
  sealed: boolean
  completedLegIds: string[]
  activeReplacementPlanIds: string[]
  timeline: TimelineEntry[]
  activeJourneyId?: string
  currentHolderId?: string
  receivedLaboratoryId?: string
  exception?: Record<string, unknown>
  pendingHandoffId?: string
  pendingHandoff?: Record<string, unknown>
  latestLocation?: Coordinate
  locationRecordedAt?: string
  locationStale: boolean
}

export interface JourneyStop {
  stopId: string
  locationId: string
  stopType: 'pickup' | 'handoff' | 'delivery'
  sequence: number
  estimatedAt: string
  dwellMinutes?: number
  coordinate?: Coordinate
  completedAt?: string
}

export interface JourneyLeg {
  assignmentId: string
  sequence: number
  status: string
  fromLocationId?: string
  toLocationId?: string
  workerId?: string
  sampleId?: string
}

export interface JourneyPlan {
  journeyId: string
  parentJourneyId?: string
  planVersion?: number
  routeMode?: string
  status?: string
  estimatedDeliveryAt?: string
  totalCostUnits?: number
  capacityUsed?: number
  capacityAvailable?: number
  sampleIds?: string[]
  orderedStops?: JourneyStop[]
  legs: JourneyLeg[]
  assignedWorkerIds?: string[]
  collectionAssignmentId?: string
  collectionAssignmentIds?: string[]
  nodeAssignmentIds?: string[]
  laboratoryAssignmentIds?: string[]
  valid?: boolean
  replanStatus?: string
  scope?: string
  assignmentIds?: string[]
}

export interface SampleWorkItem {
  kind: 'sample'
  sampleId: string
  requestId: string
  status: string
  serviceability?: string

  locationStale: boolean

  kind: 'journey'
  journeyId: string
  status: string
  routeMode: string

  sampleIds: string[]

  history: TimelineEntry[]

  sampleId: string

  toLocationId?: string

  offerExpiresAt?: string

  outgoingToLocationId?: string

  status: string

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate app-setup/openapi.json from the pinned contract, adding descriptions.

The structure (paths, methods, schemas, status codes, field names) is copied
verbatim from contracts/openapi.contract.json so the published document
matches the implemented API exactly; only descriptive text and the server
URL are added.
"""
import json
import pathlib

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "contracts" / "openapi.contract.json"
DST = ROOT / "app-setup" / "openapi.json"

DESCRIPTIONS = {
    "authenticate_user": ("Sign in", "Authenticate with username and password. Returns a bearer session token, the roles held by the account and the active role (empty when the account holds several roles and one must be selected with select_active_role)."),
    "select_active_role": ("Select active role", "Choose the role the session works under. Permissions and work views use the selected role; switching never adds or removes roles from the account."),
    "read_ui_bootstrap": ("UI bootstrap", "Session, catalogue and role context needed to render the UI. Requesters receive their own samples; dispatchers and administrators receive the operations state."),
    "create_user": ("Create user", "Administrator only. Creates a user with roles, qualifications, professional certifications and, for node handlers and laboratory operators, the assigned node or laboratory."),
    "read_user": ("Read user", "Read a user's profile. Administrators may read anyone; other users may only read themselves."),
    "update_user_access": ("Update user access", "Administrator only. Replace a user's roles, qualifications, certifications, active flag and assigned location."),
    "set_worker_availability": ("Set worker availability", "Mark a worker available or unavailable and set their carrying capacity. Workers may update themselves; dispatchers and administrators may update anyone."),
    "create_location": ("Create location", "Administrator only. Create a network node that may act as collection point, transfer point, hub and/or laboratory. Coverage is limited to 5 km."),
    "update_location": ("Update location", "Administrator only. Update a location's name, coordinate, coverage, handling time and functions. Triggers a new serviceability snapshot."),
    "set_location_status": ("Activate or deactivate location", "Administrator only. Toggle a whole location without restarting. Deactivation replans unfinished journeys that depend on it."),
    "set_location_function_status": ("Activate or deactivate a location function", "Administrator only. Toggle a single function (collection_point, transfer_point, hub, laboratory) of a location."),
    "create_connection": ("Create connection", "Administrator only. Create a directed transport connection between two locations with travel time, cost and whether cooled transport is available."),
    "set_connection_status": ("Activate or deactivate connection", "Administrator only. Toggle a connection; deactivation replans unfinished journeys using it."),
    "configure_capacity": ("Configure capacity", "Set regular and cooled capacity for a location or a connection. Administrators may configure any resource; node handlers and laboratory operators only their assigned location. Capacity cannot drop below currently reserved units."),
    "configure_laboratory_acceptance": ("Configure laboratory acceptance", "Administrator only. Declare whether a laboratory accepts a sample type."),
    "create_sample_type": ("Create sample type", "Administrator only. Define a sample type with container, temperature range, incompatibilities, qualified-collector, cooled-route and batching rules."),
    "update_sample_type": ("Update sample type", "Administrator only. Update handling attributes of an existing sample type."),
    "read_serviceability_snapshot": ("Read serviceability snapshot", "Return the currently published, complete serviceability-calculation version with its coverage regions."),
    "check_serviceability": ("Check serviceability (dry run)", "Evaluate whether an origin and sample type can be serviced before a deadline. Creates nothing: no request, sample, journey, assignment or reservation."),
    "create_collection_request": ("Create collection request", "Create a home, clinic or node collection request. Plans the journey, reserves capacity and offers a collection assignment to a qualified collector."),
    "ingest_presealed_sample": ("Register pre-sealed sample", "Register a sample already collected and sealed by the caller (who becomes current holder). Origin must be a clinic or node; only onward transport legs are created."),
    "read_sample_state": ("Read sample state", "Full sample state including serviceability, active assignments, status timeline, latest location and staleness. Requesters see only their own samples."),
    "read_sample_lifecycle": ("Read sample lifecycle", "Lifecycle view: status, seal state, completed legs, current holder, pending handoff, exception and ordered timeline."),
    "list_role_work": ("List role work", "Pending, in-progress and completed work for the session's selected role."),
    "accept_assignment": ("Accept assignment", "Accept an offered collection, transport, node or laboratory assignment. Only the worker it was offered to may accept."),
    "decline_assignment": ("Decline assignment", "Decline an offered assignment; it is re-offered to the next eligible worker."),
    "collect_and_seal_sample": ("Collect and seal sample", "Certified collector records collection inside the collection window and seals the sample, becoming its holder. Container and temperature must satisfy the sample rules."),
    "update_assignment_progress": ("Update assignment progress", "Record progress on an accepted assignment (at_pickup, picked_up, in_transit, arrived, delivered, in_progress, completed)."),
    "record_worker_location": ("Record worker location", "Record a worker's current coordinate for an assignment. Sequence numbers must increase; older samples are rejected as stale."),
    "initiate_handoff": ("Initiate handoff", "Current holder initiates custody transfer to the worker of the adjacent assignment. The sender remains responsible until both sides confirm."),
    "confirm_handoff": ("Confirm handoff", "Sender or receiver confirms a pending handoff. Custody moves only when both have confirmed; repeated confirmations are idempotent."),
    "confirm_laboratory_receipt": ("Confirm laboratory receipt", "Laboratory operator assigned to the laboratory confirms receipt, completing the journey."),
    "record_laboratory_exception": ("Record laboratory exception", "Laboratory operator records that a sample cannot be accepted normally."),
    "record_handling_checkpoint": ("Record handling checkpoint", "Current holder records observed container and temperature; non-compliant observations mark the sample as an exception."),
    "read_journey_plan": ("Read journey plan", "Journey plan scoped to the caller: full plan for dispatchers/administrators, requester summary for the owning requester, assigned legs only for workers."),
    "edit_active_plan": ("Edit active plan", "Dispatcher change to an unfinished journey (stops, workers, reroute, cancel). Validated against eligibility, compatibility, capacity and deadlines with plan-version checks."),
    "split_journey": ("Split journey", "Move some samples of a batched journey into a new journey."),
    "merge_journeys": ("Merge journeys", "Merge compatible unfinished journeys into one batch."),
    "cancel_journey": ("Cancel journey", "Cancel unfinished work of a journey, releasing reservations and open offers."),
    "reroute_journey": ("Reroute journey", "Replan the unfinished portion of a journey keeping the current holder and completed work."),
    "report_disruption": ("Report disruption", "Mark a location, connection, worker or capacity pool unavailable and replan every affected unfinished journey."),
    "read_operations_state": ("Read operations state", "Dispatcher monitor: samples, workers, locations, connections, routes, handoffs, delays and exceptions."),
    "search_audit_trail": ("Search audit trail", "Search audit records by actor, role, action, entity, outcome, time range and free text."),
    "stream_realtime_events": ("Realtime events", "WebSocket (subprotocol lab-logistics-v1) or HTTP long-poll of durable realtime events, resumable with the since cursor."),
    "system_readiness": ("Readiness", "Returns {\"status\":\"ready\"} only when the application can serve requests and reach PostgreSQL."),
}

ERROR_DESCRIPTIONS = {
    "200": "Success", "201": "Created", "101": "Switching protocols (WebSocket)",
    "400": "Malformed or invalid request", "401": "Missing or invalid session token",
    "403": "Role or ownership does not permit this action", "404": "Entity not found",
    "405": "Method not allowed", "409": "Conflict with current state", "500": "Internal error",
    "503": "Not ready",
}


def main():
    doc = json.loads(SRC.read_text())
    doc["info"] = {
        "title": "Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery API",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "description": "Role-based API for clinical sample collection, transport, custody and laboratory receipt. All responses wrap payloads in {\"data\": ...}; errors use {\"error\", \"code\"}. Mutating operations identified by idempotencyKey replay the original result for the same key and reject reuse with a different body.",
    }
    doc["servers"] = [{"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8080"}]
    doc["components"]["securitySchemes"]["BearerAuth"]["description"] = "Session token returned by authenticate_user, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>."
    for path, ops in doc["paths"].items():
        for method, op in ops.items():
            if method not in ("get", "post", "put", "patch", "delete"):
                continue
            summ, desc = DESCRIPTIONS[op["operationId"]]
            op["summary"] = summ
            op["description"] = desc
            for code, resp in op["responses"].items():
                if not resp.get("description"):
                    resp["description"] = ERROR_DESCRIPTIONS.get(code, "")
    DST.write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {DST}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Browser walkthrough of the UI against a running, smoke-tested application.

Requires playwright (pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium).
Run after scripts/smoke_test.py so that users and samples exist.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.request

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = os.environ.get("UI_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN = (os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin"), os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123"))
failures = 0


def check(cond, label):
    global failures
    print(("  ok   " if cond else "  FAIL ") + label)
    if not cond:
        failures += 1


def api(path, body, token=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/api/" + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())["data"]


def login(page, username, password):
    page.goto(BASE + "/login")
    page.get_by_label("Username").fill(username)
    page.get_by_label("Password").fill(password)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").click()


def main():
    console = []
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900})
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.on("console", lambda m: console.append((m.type, m.text)))
        page.on("pageerror", lambda e: console.append(("pageerror", str(e))))
        external = []
        page.on("request", lambda r: external.append(r.url) if not r.url.startswith(BASE) else None)

        print("== login")
        login(page, ADMIN[0], "wrong-password")
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        check("invalid" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower(), "invalid credentials rejected with visible error")
        login(page, *ADMIN)
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").wait_for()
        check(True, "admin signed in")

        print("== role switch")
        sel = page.get_by_label("Active role")
        check(sel.count() == 1, "role selector present")
        options = sel.locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        check("Administrator" in options and "Dispatcher" in options, f"role options listed: {options}")
        sel.select_option("dispatcher")
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)
        check("Dispatcher" in page.get_by_role("banner").inner_text(), "dispatcher role applied in header")

        print("== monitor")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Monitor").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="Operations monitor").wait_for()
        txt = page.locator("main").inner_text()
        for cat in ["Samples", "Workers", "Locations", "Connections", "Exceptions"]:
            check(cat in txt, f"monitor category {cat}")
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        check(page.locator("canvas.maplibregl-canvas").count() >= 1, "map canvas rendered")
        check("OpenStreetMap contributors" in page.locator("main").inner_text(), "OSM attribution visible")
        check(not external, f"no external network requests ({len(external)})")

        print("== audit")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Audit").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="Audit trail").wait_for()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        check(page.get_by_role("table").count() >= 1, "audit table rendered")
        page.get_by_label("Action").fill("user.sign_in")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        rows = page.get_by_role("table").locator("tbody tr").all_inner_texts()
        check(rows and all("sign_in" in r for r in rows), f"audit search filters by action ({len(rows)} rows)")

        print("== admin")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Admin").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="Administration").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("tab", name="Locations").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        check(page.get_by_role("table").count() >= 1, "locations table rendered")

        print("== sign out")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        page.goto(BASE + "/work")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        check(True, "sign out ends session; protected route redirects to login")

        # Requester flow: use the smoke-test requester if present.
        print("== requester")
        admin_tok = api("authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN[0], "password": ADMIN[1]})["sessionToken"]
        api("select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, admin_tok)
        try:
            api("create-user", {"username": "ui_requester", "initialPassword": "pw12345", "fullName": "UI Requester", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, admin_tok)
        except Exception:
            pass
        login(page, "ui_requester", "pw12345")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="New collection request").wait_for()
        page.get_by_label("Latitude").fill("40")
        page.get_by_label("Longitude").fill("-70")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Check serviceability").click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        check("unserviceable" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower() or "outside" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower(), "dry run surfaces unserviceable")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="My work").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(600)
        before = len(page.locator(".work-item").all())
        check(before == 0, "dry run created no request")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_label("Latitude").fill("12.97")
        page.get_by_label("Longitude").fill("77.59")
        page.get_by_label("Delivery deadline").fill("2000-01-01T10:00")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Create request").click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        check("deadline" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower(), "request form surfaces validation error")

        print("== worker capacity")
        samples = api("list-role-work", {}, api("authenticate-user", {"username": "lab_whitefield", "password": "pw12345"})["sessionToken"]) if False else None
        login(page, "lab_whitefield", "pw12345")
        if page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").count() == 0 and page.get_by_role("alert").count():
            print("  skip lab worker (user not present)")
        else:
            page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").wait_for()
            page.get_by_role("link", name="Capacity").click()
            page.get_by_role("heading", name="Capacity at").wait_for()
            check("configured" in page.locator("main").inner_text(), "lab worker sees own capacity")
            page.get_by_label("Regular capacity units").fill("42")
            page.get_by_role("button", name="Save capacity").click()
            page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
            page.wait_for_timeout(800)
            check("42 configured" in page.locator("main").inner_text(), "capacity change written through")
            page.get_by_role("link", name="My work").click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(600)
            txt = page.locator("main").inner_text()
            check("Completed" in txt and "Pending" in txt, "work view shows current and past sections")

        browser.close()
    errors = [c for c in console if c[0] in ("error", "pageerror")]
    check(not errors, f"no console errors ({errors[:3]})")
    print("\nall UI checks passed" if not failures else f"\n{failures} UI check(s) failed")
    sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Browser walkthrough of the UI against a running, smoke-tested application.

Requires playwright (pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium).

"""
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.request

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = os.environ.get("UI_BASE", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
ADMIN = (os.environ.get("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin"), os.environ.get("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin123"))
failures = 0


def check(cond, label):
    global failures
    print(("  ok   " if cond else "  FAIL ") + label)
    if not cond:
        failures += 1


def api(path, body, token=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + "/api/" + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())["data"]


def login(page, username, password):
    page.goto(BASE + "/login")
    page.get_by_label("Username").fill(username)
    page.get_by_label("Password").fill(password)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").click()


def main():
    console = []
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900})
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.on("console", lambda m: console.append((m.type, m.text)))
        page.on("pageerror", lambda e: console.append(("pageerror", str(e))))
        external = []
        page.on("request", lambda r: external.append(r.url) if not r.url.startswith(BASE) else None)

        print("== login")
        login(page, ADMIN[0], "wrong-password")
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        check("invalid" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower(), "invalid credentials rejected with visible error")
        login(page, *ADMIN)
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").wait_for()
        check(True, "admin signed in")

        print("== role switch")
        sel = page.get_by_label("Active role")
        check(sel.count() == 1, "role selector present")
        options = sel.locator("option").all_inner_texts()
        check("Administrator" in options and "Dispatcher" in options, f"role options listed: {options}")
        sel.select_option("dispatcher")
        page.wait_for_timeout(500)
        check("Dispatcher" in page.get_by_role("banner").inner_text(), "dispatcher role applied in header")

        print("== monitor")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Monitor").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="Operations monitor").wait_for()
        txt = page.locator("main").inner_text()
        for cat in ["Samples", "Workers", "Locations", "Connections", "Exceptions"]:
            check(cat in txt, f"monitor category {cat}")
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        check(page.locator("canvas.maplibregl-canvas").count() >= 1, "map canvas rendered")
        check("OpenStreetMap contributors" in page.locator("main").inner_text(), "OSM attribution visible")
        check(not external, f"no external network requests ({len(external)})")

        print("== audit")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Audit").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="Audit trail").wait_for()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        check(page.get_by_role("table").count() >= 1, "audit table rendered")
        page.get_by_label("Action").fill("user.sign_in")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        rows = page.get_by_role("table").locator("tbody tr").all_inner_texts()
        check(rows and all("sign_in" in r for r in rows), f"audit search filters by action ({len(rows)} rows)")

        print("== admin")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Administration").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="Administration").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("tab", name="Locations").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        check(page.get_by_role("table").count() >= 1, "locations table rendered")

        print("== sign out")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").click()
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        page.goto(BASE + "/work")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in").wait_for()
        check(True, "sign out ends session; protected route redirects to login")

        # Requester flow: use the smoke-test requester if present.
        print("== requester")
        admin_tok = api("authenticate-user", {"username": ADMIN[0], "password": ADMIN[1]})["sessionToken"]
        api("select-active-role", {"role": "administrator"}, admin_tok)
        try:
            api("create-user", {"username": "ui_requester", "initialPassword": "pw12345", "fullName": "UI Requester", "roles": ["requester"], "active": True}, admin_tok)
        except Exception:
            pass
        login(page, "ui_requester", "pw12345")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").wait_for()
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_role("heading", name="New collection request").wait_for()
        page.get_by_label("Latitude").fill("40")
        page.get_by_label("Longitude").fill("-70")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Check serviceability").click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        check("unserviceable" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower() or "outside" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower(), "dry run surfaces unserviceable")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="My work").click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(600)
        before = len(page.locator(".work-item").all())
        check(before == 0, "dry run created no request")
        page.get_by_role("link", name="New request").click()
        page.get_by_label("Latitude").fill("12.97")
        page.get_by_label("Longitude").fill("77.59")
        page.get_by_label("Delivery deadline").fill("2000-01-01T10:00")
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Create request").click()
        page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
        check("deadline" in page.get_by_role("alert").inner_text().lower(), "request form surfaces validation error")

        print("== worker capacity")
        pass
        login(page, "labop", "pw-labop")
        if page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").count() == 0 and page.get_by_role("alert").count():
            print("  skip lab worker (user not present)")
        else:
            page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign out").wait_for()
            page.get_by_role("link", name="Capacity").click()
            page.get_by_role("heading", name="Capacity at").wait_for()
            check("configured" in page.locator("main").inner_text(), "lab worker sees own capacity")
            page.get_by_label("Regular capacity units").fill("42")
            page.get_by_role("button", name="Save capacity").click()
            page.get_by_role("alert").wait_for()
            page.wait_for_timeout(800)
            check("42 configured" in page.locator("main").inner_text(), "capacity change written through")
            page.get_by_role("link", name="My work").click()
            page.wait_for_timeout(600)
            txt = page.locator("main").inner_text()
            check("Completed" in txt and "Pending" in txt, "work view shows current and past sections")

        browser.close()
    errors = [c for c in console if c[0] in ("error", "pageerror")]
    check(not errors, f"no console errors ({errors[:3]})")
    print("\nall UI checks passed" if not failures else f"\n{failures} UI check(s) failed")
    sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
